title: 第11章 卖酒第12章 回邹家村
content_zh:
追梦所说的用芦苇酿酒，其实是用芦苇的根和黄酒一起酿酒。
酿出的酒名为芦苇根酒。
追梦之所以要酿这种酒是考虑二点。
第一点，随着鱼肉被追梦带进市场，吃鱼肉的人将越来越多，这过程中难免会出现有吃鱼肉中毒的情况。
这样一来，就影响追梦家卖鱼肉生意。
芦苇根酒正好是追梦知道的一种药酒。
药用功效具有解毒杀虫的作用，能够帮助身体排出毒素，缓解因食用鱼蟹等引起的中毒症状。
同时，还有利小便的功效，可促进尿液排出，减轻身体水肿，有助于肾脏功能的正常运行。
这个功效正好解决吃鱼肉中毒问题。
第二点，芦苇根酒，也是一种保健品。
具有一定的药用价值和保健作用。
追梦准备酿造出来后好好包装一下，作为以后独家挣钱营生。
次日，追梦早早的起床，经过一番打听之后，追梦找到了柳城出名的铁匠轩辕二锤的住处。
“轩辕师傅在家吗？”
走进轩辕二锤的住处，追梦对着一个正在打铁的青年问道。
“师父老人家在休息，你有事吗？大事我去通传给师父，小事跟我说也是一样”
打铁的青年反问道。
“没什么大事，就是想找轩辕师傅帮忙打造些东西。”
“嗯！
说说，是打造什么东西。”

“这两张图上画的这些东西。”
追梦把画好的两张图纸递给青年。
“这是什么？我没见过！”
青年看着图纸一脸问号，可能是从来没接触过。
追梦没有回答，心里笑道:“这是21世纪的一些酿酒和蒸馏酒的器具，你能知道才怪！”
“客人请稍等，我去叫师傅，想必他老人家应该知道怎么制作。”
青年见追梦没有回答自己的问题，只是看着自己，青年没有继续寻问，开口要去找师父。
不一会儿，青年带着一个全身都是腱子肉的大叔从内屋中走出。
“你好！
少年，听小徒说是你要打造这些特殊的器具？”
大叔指着追梦给的画图说的。
“你就是柳城出名的轩辕大师吧？”
见大叔点头，追梦又问道:“打造图纸上这些东西有没有困难？”
“困难倒是没有，但我很好奇，这图纸上绘制出来的东西，到底是用来做什么的。”
轩辕二锤没有见过图纸上所画的工具，好奇的问道。
“这个是我的隐私，轩辕大叔你没必要知道。
既然能打造，你就说说打造这些工具要多久，需要多少银钱就是”
追梦不愿透露商机，严肃的问道。
“呵！
呵呵”

轩辕二锤不好意思的摸摸头后勺，接着又说道:“要是你能告诉我，图纸上的东西打造出来是用来做什么的，我可以给你打两折。”
“两折！
老板这会不会有点少，这玩意我可是有大用的。”
追梦说道。
“最多5折，”
content_en:
What Zhui Meng said about using reeds to make wine is actually using the roots of the reeds and rice wine to make wine.
The brewed wine is called reed root wine.
The reason why Dream Chasing wants to brew this kind of wine is to consider two points.
First, as fish is brought to the market by Dream Chaser, more and more people will eat fish, and it is inevitable that fish poisoning will occur in the process.
This will affect the dream chaser's fish and meat business.
Reed root wine happens to be a kind of medicinal wine that Zhui Meng knows.
The medicinal effect is detoxification and insecticide, which can help the body eliminate toxins and relieve poisoning symptoms caused by eating fish and crabs.
At the same time, it also has the effect of facilitating urination, promoting urine excretion, reducing body edema, and contributing to the normal operation of kidney function.
This effect just solves the problem of fish poisoning.
The second point is that reed root wine is also a health product.
It has certain medicinal value and health care effect.
Chai Meng is going to brew it and package it well as a way to make money exclusively in the future.
The next day, Zhui Meng got up early. After some inquiries, Zhui Meng found the residence of Xuanyuan Erchui, a famous blacksmith in Liucheng.
"Is Master Xuanyuan at home?"
Walking into Xuanyuan Erchui's residence, Zhui Meng asked a young man who was blacksmithing.
"Master is resting, are you okay? I will inform Master about big things, and the same thing about small things."
The blacksmith young man asked rhetorically.
"It's nothing serious, I just want to ask Master Xuanyuan to help me build something."
"Hmm!
Tell me what you are building. "
"These are the things drawn in these two pictures."
Zhui Meng handed the two drawings he had drawn to the young man.
"What is this? I've never seen it before!"
The young man looked at the drawings with a question mark on his face, maybe he had never been exposed to it before.
Zhui Meng did not answer, but smiled in his heart: "These are some brewing and distilling equipment of the 21st century. It would be strange for you to know!"
"Guest, please wait a moment. I'll call the master. He must know how to make it."
Seeing that Zhui Meng did not answer his question, but just looked at him, the young man did not continue to ask, and opened his mouth to find the master.
After a while, the young man walked out of the inner room with an old man covered in tendons.
"Hello!
Young man, I heard from my disciple that you want to build these special tools? "
The uncle said, pointing to the drawing given by Zhui Meng.
"Are you the famous Master Xuanyuan in Liucheng?"
Seeing the uncle nod, Zhui Meng asked again: "Is it difficult to create these things in the drawings?"
"It's not difficult, but I'm curious about what the things drawn on this drawing are used for."
Xuanyuan Erchui asked curiously as he had never seen the tools drawn on the drawing.
"This is my privacy, Uncle Xuanyuan, you don't need to know.
Since you can build them, just tell me how long it will take to build these tools and how much money it will cost.”
Chai Meng asked seriously as he did not want to reveal the business opportunity.
"Ha!
Haha”
Xuanyuan Erchui touched the back of his head in embarrassment, and then said: "If you can tell me what the things on the drawing are used for, I can give you a 20% discount."
“Two discounts!
Boss, isn't this a bit too much? This thing is of great use to me. "
Chai Meng said.
“Up to 50% off,”
